_source.basis: 2016 Fare Review Exercise. When rail fares became purely distance-based, eight station pairs would have paid more despite the overall reduction that year; the PTC kept them cheaper with a fixed discount off the band fare, so no commuter was worse off.
_source.confirmedBy: PTC reply to an enquiry of 31 August 2026, received 2026-09-25: Bishan to Toa Payoh is 2.1 km, in the up-to-3.2 km band at $1.28 adult, less a 4-cent exception, so $1.24.
_source.checked: LTA fare calculator, all five card types for all eight pairs, 2026-09-25. Adult and Workfare are discounted; Student, Senior and Persons with Disabilities pay the band fare on these pairs.
_source.note: Discounts in cents, applied to the band fare, because that is how the PTC states them. Keys are the sorted station pair as in fare-distances.json. These are the same eight pairs the fare import flagged as disagreeing with the band table on 2026-09-13.
